body.condition: \(\varepsilon_i=s_iZ_i\), where the \(Z_i\) are independent standard centered Laplace variables and \(s_i\in[s_-,s_+]\).

novel.justification: The scaled-Laplace family is a deliberate, transparent inference benchmark rather than a standard LiNG assumption. It supplies non-Gaussian sources with explicit characteristic functions and bounded scale uncertainty, while allowing every graph in the finite family through interior scale choices.
